name: Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana Scheme
benefit: Surgeries Covered in this SchemeCardiovascular Surgeries (a total 153 Benefit Packages) Neurosurgery (a total 49 Benefit Packages) Burns (a total 12 Benefit Packages) Poly Trauma (Not covered by Motor Vehicle Insurance) (a total 8 Benefit Packages) Cancer (Malignancies) (Surgical Oncology, Chemotherapy & Radiation Oncology) (a total 210 Benefit Packages) Renal (Kidney) (a total 21 Benefit Packages) Neonatal (newborn) diseases (a total 23 Benefit Packages) Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana provides quality medical and surgical care for catastrophic illnesses involving hospitalization, surgeries and therapies through an em panel network of hospitals to the BPL families.
eligibility_rules: The individuals and families listed in the BPL list by the State Government are eligible under the MA Yojana. Furthermore, each family member should be present when enrolled under the scheme. However, families that belong marginally above the poverty line can be under the MA Vatsalya Yojana if they follow these criteria - 1) The annual income of the family is up to ₹4 Lakhs
Any member(s) who are Accredited Social Health Activist (ASHA) workers
Any member(s) who have accredited reporters
Class-3 and Class-4 employees employed on a fixed payroll by the State Government
Senior Citizens with families of a total annual income of up to ₹6 Lakhs
documents_required: List of the required documentsAddress proof. Identification proof. Proof of income. Certificate
saying that your family qualifies for the below
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Application FormThe eligible beneficiaries must visit the Kiosks at Taluka or Civic Centres in their area. Mobile kiosks are also available at a local level. The authorities are well equipped with the needed hardware for enrolment. The hardware is used to capture biometrics such as fingerprints, iris scans, and photos of the beneficiaries. The beneficiaries might even have to fill out the MA Card application form in Gujarati with appropriate details. Once the details are verified, the MA health card is issued to the beneficiaries and the enrolment process is complete.
